info.title: aarde API
info.description:
Read-only imagery catalog API served by aarde. Imports are local CLI operations and are not exposed here.

Use **Authorize** to enter the web token from the private token file named in the server startup log. Enter only the token, without the Bearer prefix. Swagger stores authorization in memory and clears it on reload.

All operations require authentication by default. With AARDE_WEB_PUBLIC_READ=true, registered reads including POST /api/v1/imagery/search accept anonymous requests; this served specification reflects that setting. Explicitly supplied invalid tokens are always rejected. API responses are not cached.

This reference and /openapi.json are public and contain no catalog data or credentials. Try it out sends real requests to this server.

Viewer manifest and layer content always require bearer authentication, even when catalog browsing is public.

get.description: Exact, case-sensitive IDs. Results are ordered by import time descending, then UUID. Concurrent imports can shift offset-based pages.

parameters.name: catalog_id
parameters.description: Exact catalog ID. Omit or use an empty string for all catalogs.

parameters.name: image_id

items.description: Exact, case-sensitive ID: 1–255 UTF-8 bytes, no slashes, backslashes, control characters, or surrounding whitespace.

parameters.description: Repeat this query parameter for up to 100 exact image IDs.

parameters.name: cloud_cover_lt
parameters.description: Reported scene cloud cover strictly less than this finite percentage (0–100). Zero matches no known values; 100 excludes fully cloudy scenes. Cannot be combined with cloud_cover_lte. Unknown values are excluded by default when a threshold is supplied; cloud_cover_unknown overrides this. All filters combine with AND before ordering and pagination. Omit for no threshold. An empty query value is invalid.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size; values outside 1–200 are rejected.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of records to skip.

parameters.name: cloud_cover_lte
parameters.description: Reported scene cloud cover at most this finite percentage (0–100). Includes the exact boundary, including 0 and 100. Cannot be combined with cloud_cover_lt. Unknown values are excluded by default; use cloud_cover_unknown=include to retain them. Describes the whole scene, not clouds within the search area. An empty query value is invalid.

parameters.name: cloud_cover_unknown
parameters.description: Unknown cloud-cover policy. Defaults to exclude with either threshold and include otherwise. exclude without a threshold returns only known values; only returns unknown values and cannot be combined with either threshold. An empty query value is invalid.

parameters.name: acquired_from
parameters.description: Inclusive acquisition timestamp (RFC3339). A date bound excludes imagery with unknown acquisition time. Must precede acquired_before when both are supplied. An empty query value is invalid.

parameters.name: acquired_before
parameters.description: Exclusive acquisition timestamp (RFC3339). For an inclusive Through day, send midnight UTC of the following day. A date bound excludes imagery with unknown acquisition time. An empty query value is invalid.

401.description: A valid aarde web token is required

400.description: Invalid pagination, IDs, date bounds, cloud thresholds, or unknown-cloud policy.

post.description: Read-only search: never mutates the catalog. Indexed PostGIS ST_Intersects includes partial overlap and boundary contact and respects holes. Results use the same ordering and pagination as GET /imagery. Anonymous requests are allowed when public reads are enabled. Two-dimensional EPSG:4326 coordinates, longitude then latitude. Rings must be closed, with at least four positions each. At most 10,000 positions across the geometry. PostGIS validates topology, including self-intersections. Split antimeridian crossings into a MultiPolygon; edges spanning more than 180 degrees longitude are rejected. GeoJSON Feature and FeatureCollection wrappers are not accepted.

requestBody.description: One JSON object, at most 1 MiB.

get.description: Always authenticated. One complete segment image per raster response. Placement mesh maps original pixel edges into a common image-coordinate plane (x right, y up). Display downsampling never changes placement. Geometry coordinates use this same manifest coordinate system, not RFC7946 longitude/latitude. Opacity/pan/zoom do not request content. Cloud grids support NCDRD 2010 Byte values 0/255 with reserved values shown distinctly; CSSHPA v01 polygons are bounded and transformed. No RPC/DEM orthorectification.

bearerAuth.description: Startup web token. Enter the token only, without the Bearer prefix.

items.description: Exact, case-sensitive ID: 1–255 UTF-8 bytes, no slashes, backslashes, control characters, or surrounding whitespace.

Geometry.description: Two-dimensional EPSG:4326 coordinates, longitude then latitude. Rings must be closed, with at least four positions each. At most 10,000 positions across the geometry. PostGIS validates topology, including self-intersections. Split antimeridian crossings into a MultiPolygon; edges spanning more than 180 degrees longitude are rejected. GeoJSON Feature and FeatureCollection wrappers are not accepted.

catalog_id.description: Omit or pass an empty string to search all catalogs. Otherwise use a valid catalog ID.

cloud_cover_lt.description: Reported scene cloud cover strictly less than this finite percentage (0–100). Zero matches no known values; 100 excludes fully cloudy scenes. Cannot be combined with cloud_cover_lte. Unknown values are excluded by default when a threshold is supplied; cloud_cover_unknown overrides this. All filters combine with AND before ordering and pagination. Omit or pass null for no threshold.

cloud_cover_lte.description: Reported scene cloud cover at most this finite percentage (0–100). Includes the exact boundary, including 0 and 100. Cannot be combined with cloud_cover_lt. Unknown values are excluded by default; use cloud_cover_unknown=include to retain them. Describes the whole scene, not clouds within the search area. Omit or pass null for the default.

cloud_cover_unknown.description: Unknown cloud-cover policy. Defaults to exclude with either threshold and include otherwise. exclude without a threshold returns only known values; only returns unknown values and cannot be combined with either threshold. Omit or pass null for the default.

acquired_from.description: Inclusive acquisition timestamp (RFC3339). A date bound excludes imagery with unknown acquisition time. Must precede acquired_before when both are supplied. Omit or pass null for the default.

acquired_before.description: Exclusive acquisition timestamp (RFC3339). For an inclusive Through day, send midnight UTC of the following day. A date bound excludes imagery with unknown acquisition time. Omit or pass null for the default.

image_ids.description: Exact, case-sensitive image IDs, matching any listed ID and all other filters. IDs follow the same byte and character restrictions as GET image_id. Omit, use null, or an empty array for any ID.

SearchRequest.description: Intersecting geometry is required. Exact image IDs match by OR; all filter groups combine with AND before stable import-time ordering and pagination. Date bounds and cloud semantics match GET /imagery.

catalog_id.description: Exact, case-sensitive ID: 1–255 UTF-8 bytes, no slashes, backslashes, control characters, or surrounding whitespace.

image_id.description: Exact, case-sensitive ID: 1–255 UTF-8 bytes, no slashes, backslashes, control characters, or surrounding whitespace.

acquired_at.description: For multi-image NITF, a unanimous known segment time, otherwise null.

asset_location.description: Local asset path on the server; this API does not download raster files.

width.description: Positive for a single raster; 0 (unavailable) for multi-image NITF. See segments.

height.description: Positive for a single raster; 0 (unavailable) for multi-image NITF. See segments.

band_count.description: Positive for a single raster; 0 (unavailable) for multi-image NITF. See segments.

source_crs.description: Source CRS for a single raster; empty for multi-image NITF. See segments.

metadata.description: Selected GDAL metadata domains preserved as JSON, including object and XML values. The reserved _aarde namespace contains format, georeferencing, and footprint-method annotations; handling markings are metadata, not access controls.

cloud_cover.description: File-level override, or unanimous known segment percentage for multi-image NITF, otherwise null.

format.description: GDAL-detected source format, stored at import. Null for records imported before format annotations; never inferred from the filename.

segments.description: NITF image segments in zero-based index order; absent or empty for legacy records and GeoTIFF.

InvalidRequest.description: Invalid pagination, catalog/image IDs, RFC3339 date bounds, cloud thresholds, or cloud_cover_unknown policy. Thresholds must be finite percentages from 0 to 100 and cannot be combined. Unknown-only cannot be combined with a threshold. Spatial search requires valid polygon geometry and a single JSON object with known fields.

InvalidSearch.description: Invalid pagination, catalog/image IDs, RFC3339 date bounds, cloud thresholds, or cloud_cover_unknown policy. Thresholds must be finite percentages from 0 to 100 and cannot be combined. Unknown-only cannot be combined with a threshold. Spatial search requires valid polygon geometry and a single JSON object with known fields.
